title: 第一卷 第17章 极限圣体，万古青天一株莲！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
姜家祖地，姜无痕跟在姜临天身后，站在了五座巨大的神源面前。

    所谓神源，是灵石的一种。

    不过，却是圣人以上的强者，才有能力炼化的修炼资源。

    即便只是拳头大小的神源块，就价值连城，足以换来数万枚极品灵石！

    可就是这样珍贵的修炼资源，在姜家祖地，却有五座大山！

    “诸位老祖，这位小辈乃是我姜家恒御大帝之子，名叫无痕！”

    姜临天先是介绍了姜无痕，随即将系统的存在，告知了几位老祖。

    即便是大帝，听到这样的事情，同样感觉匪夷所思。

    但很快，他们就把系统奖励归结为天道垂赐，一切就显得合理了许多。

    “原来，你是临御那小家伙的孩子，怪不得如此特殊！”

    一座神源内，传来略显得意的声音。

    姜临天轻笑，解释道：“无痕，这位是三祖，与始祖、五祖，都是我们这一脉的老祖。论辈分，是你的曾曾祖父！”

    “见过三祖，见过各位老祖！”

    姜无痕恭敬道。

    “无需多礼！”

    始祖的神源发出波动，沧桑的声音在祖地回荡：“临天，你方才说……无痕刚得到了新的奖励，那一枚元圣丹和三枚天圣丹要怎么用，可有人选？”

    “回禀始祖，如今姜家小辈之中，还有两位神体，因此……我在考虑，将其中一枚天圣丹赐予一位拥有王体的小辈，或者……赐予一位年龄稍大些的神体……”

    姜临天沉思片刻后，继续道：“至于这枚元圣丹，暂时还没想好赐予哪位小辈……”

    将觉醒的机会留给家族小辈，是能够让整个姜家利益最大化的选择！

    但特殊体质万中无一，即便是姜家，也没有太多的神体。

    沉默片刻后，始祖再次开口道：“既然已经有了两位人选，便将此二人召来祖地。让我们几个老家伙也见识一下，血脉升华的过程！”

    即便他们相信姜临天的话，但这种破天荒的事情，还是得亲眼见证才放心。

    姜临天心领神会，立刻派遣镇守祖地的家族强者去接人。

    很快，一男一女来到了祖地。

    男人名叫姜凌尘，来自流落在下界的支脉，因在十五岁时觉醒了太初剑体，而被接引进入上界姜家。

    女人名叫姜纤纤，是大长老姜临战的孙女，属于姜家嫡系。

    她所觉醒的，乃是一种木属性神体，唤作净世莲体。

    在修仙界，木属性向来是低人一等的存在。

    净世莲体，也被称作最弱神体之一！

    “拜见老祖，拜见家主，拜见帝子！”

    二人对在场众人一一见礼。

    “此番召尔等前来，是为了赐给你们一场造化！”姜临天上前，取出了两枚天圣丹，“这是帝子赐给你们的丹药，服下之后，可突破血脉极限，晋升圣体！”

    此话一出，二人脸上皆露出惊讶之色。
content_en:
In the ancestral land of the Jiang family, Jiang Wuhen followed Jiang Lintian and stood in front of five huge divine sources.

The so-called divine source is a type of spiritual stone.

However, only those strong enough to be saints and above have the cultivation resources to refine them.

Even a fist-sized block of divine source is worth a fortune, enough to be exchanged for tens of thousands of top-quality spiritual stones!

But even with such precious cultivation resources, there are five mountains in the Jiang family’s ancestral land!

"Ancestors, this junior is the son of my great Emperor Jiang Jiahengyu, and his name is Wuhen!"

Jiang Lintian first introduced Jiang Wuhen, and then informed several ancestors of the existence of the system.

Even the emperor felt weird when he heard such things.

But soon, they attributed the system rewards to God's gift, and everything seemed much more reasonable.

"It turns out that you are the child of that little guy Linyu, no wonder you are so special!"

A slightly satisfied voice came from a divine source.

Jiang Lintian chuckled and explained: "Wuhen, this is the third ancestor. Together with the first ancestor and the fifth ancestor, he is the ancestor of our lineage. In terms of seniority, he is your great-great-grandfather!"

"I've met the third ancestor, I've met all the ancestors!"

Jiang Wuhen said respectfully.

"No need to be polite!"

The ancestor's divine source fluctuated, and the voice of vicissitudes of life echoed in the ancestral land: "Lintian, you just said... Wuhen has just received a new reward. How to use the Yuan Sheng Dan and the three Tian Sheng Dan? Is there any candidate?"

"Reporting to the ancestors, there are still two divine bodies among the younger generations of the Jiang family. Therefore... I am considering giving one of the Heavenly Saint Pills to a junior with a king's body, or... to a slightly older divine body..."

After Jiang Lintian pondered for a moment, he continued: "As for this Yuan Sheng Dan, I haven't decided which junior to give it to yet..."

Leaving the opportunity of awakening to the younger members of the family is a choice that can maximize the interests of the entire Jiang family!

But there is no such thing as a special physique. Even the Jiang family does not have many divine bodies.

After a moment of silence, the ancestor spoke again: "Now that we have two candidates, we will summon these two people to the ancestral land. Let us old guys also experience the process of blood sublimation!"

Even if they believe Jiang Lintian's words, they still have to witness such an unprecedented thing before they feel relieved.

Jiang Lintian understood this and immediately sent the strong men of the family who guarded the ancestral land to pick him up.

Soon, a man and a woman arrived at the ancestral land.

The man's name is Jiang Lingchen, and he comes from a branch that lives in the lower world. He awakened the Taichu Sword Body at the age of fifteen and was introduced to the Jiang family in the upper world.

The woman's name is Jiang Xianxian, the granddaughter of the great elder Jiang Linzhan, and a direct descendant of the Jiang family.

What she awakened was a kind of wood-attribute divine body called the Pure World Lotus Body.

In the world of immortality, wood attributes have always been inferior to others.

The Pure World Lotus Body is also known as one of the weakest divine bodies!

"Greetings to the ancestor, to the head of the family, to the emperor's son!"

The two of them greeted everyone present one by one.

"I have called you here this time to give you a fortune!" Jiang Lintian stepped forward and took out two Heavenly Holy Pills. "These are the pills given to you by the Emperor. After taking them, you can break through the limits of your bloodline and advance to the Holy Body!"

As soon as these words came out, both of their faces showed surprise.
